candidates.title: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) - 2027/28
candidates.official_source: Research Grants Council (RGC), University Grants Committee of Hong Kong
candidates.field: All disciplines - full-time PhD study at the eight UGC-funded universities
candidates.deadline_display: Initial Application opens 1 September 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time; obtain the HKPFS Reference Number by 1 December 2026 (Hong Kong Time); then submit full PhD applications to one or two universities quoting the reference number before each university's own deadline (each participating university's deadline: 1 December 2026, 11:59 pm Hong Kong Time)
candidates.funding: Annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) and a conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) per year for each awardee for a period up to three years (2026/27 figures as published by the RGC); 400 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in the 2027/28 academic year
candidates.funding_period: per year, up to three years (2026/27 published figures)
candidates.description: The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) aims at attracting the best and brightest students in the world to pursue their PhD studies in Hong Kong's universities. 400 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in the 2027/28 academic year. The scheme is open to candidates seeking admission as new full-time PhD students at the eight UGC-funded universities, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience and ethnic background.
eligibility: Seeking admission as a new full-time PhD student at one of the eight UGC-funded universities (City University of Hong Kong; Hong Kong Baptist University; Lingnan University; The Chinese University of Hong Kong; The Education University of Hong Kong; The Hong Kong Polytechnic University; The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; The University of Hong Kong)
Open irrespective of country of origin, prior work experience and ethnic background

Initial Application through the HKPFS Electronic System (HKPFSES) to obtain an HKPFS Reference Number, then full PhD applications to one or two universities (up to two programmes), subject to each university's admission requirements
For awardees who need more than three years to complete the PhD, additional support may be provided by the chosen universities
candidates.eligibility_summary: New full-time PhD applicants to the eight UGC-funded universities in Hong Kong, from any country, any field. Applications run in two steps: an Initial Application to the RGC for an HKPFS Reference Number by 1 December 2026 (Hong Kong Time), then a full PhD admission application to the chosen universities quoting that reference number before each university's own deadline.
benefits: Conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) per year
Awarded for a period up to three years
coverage: Annual stipend - HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) per year, up to three years
Conference and research-related travel allowance - HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) per year
requirements: Initial Application via the HKPFS Electronic System (HKPFSES)
Admission requirements of the selected universities and PhD programmes must be met
Submit initial applications as early as possible: some universities' application deadlines immediately follow the Initial Application deadline
application_method: Step 1 - Initial Application: online through the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme Electronic System (HKPFSES) to obtain an HKPFS Reference Number by 1 December 2026 (Hong Kong Time)
Step 2 - Full Applications: apply for PhD admission to up to two programmes at one or two universities, quoting the HKPFS Reference Number, before the universities' respective deadlines
candidates.selection_notes: Shortlisted applications, subject to their areas of studies, will be reviewed by one of the two Selection Panels comprising experts in the relevant board areas.
candidates.application_period: Opens 1 September 2026 (12:00 noon Hong Kong Time); Initial Application deadline 1 December 2026 (Hong Kong Time); participating university deadlines 1 December 2026 (11:59 pm Hong Kong Time)

logo_provenance.reason: The official RGC HKPFS site hosts banners and the participating universities' own crests (e.g. images/lg_HKUST.png) but publishes no crest or logo asset of the administering body itself, so no image is attached rather than using an unrelated university crest as the scheme's official logo.

evidence.quote: Open for applications: 1 September 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time

Eligible candidates should first make an Initial Application online through the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme Electronic System (HKPFSES) to obtain an HKPFS Reference Number by 1 December 2026 at Hong Kong Time 12:00:00 before submitting applications for PhD admission to their desired universities.
Applicants may choose up to two programmes / departments at one or two universities for PhD study under HKPFS 2027/28.

Eligibility: Candidates who are seeking admission as new full time PhD students in the following eight universities, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience and ethnic background, should be eligible to apply.

In the 2026/27 academic year, the Fellowship provides an annual stipend of HK$344,400 (approximately US$44,150) and a conference and research-related travel allowance of HK$14,400 (approximately US$1,840) per year for each awardee for a period up to three years.
400 PhD Fellowships will be awarded in the 2027/28 academic year*.
Application Deadline: 1 December 2026 (11:59pm Hong Kong Time)
